basics.name: Rik Koncel-Kedziorski
basics.label: Researcher
basics.summary: My research focuses on new methods for reasoning from data, human-computer collaboration, and improving evaluation of AI systems. Previously, I worked on those same things plus question answering, language grounding, and pragmatic meaning representation.

work.name: University of Washington, Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering
highlights: Research on language understanding and generation for scientific text, human-AI interaction, and dialog systems. PI: Noah A. Smith.

work.name: Apple
highlights: Research on personalization, preference learning, and reasoning for multimodal LLM systems; synthetic data generation for user-adaptive models.

work.name: S&P Global, Kensho
highlights: Research on financial NLP and reasoning; datasets and evaluation methods for LLM-based financial question answering.

work.name: Amazon
highlights: Generative question answering for Alexa; retrieval-augmented generation and multilingual QA.

education.description: Dissertation: Understanding and Generating Multi-sentence Texts. Advisors: Hanna Hajishirzi & Gina-Anne Levow.
